prior_attempts: The first menu-wrapper lifecycle fixture asserted GtkBin child assignment inside parent-set, which GTK emits before assigning its child slot. The synchronous parent identity remains checked; exact bin-child identity is checked after the native add returns. Both focused HiDPI cases pass with that timing correction.

The first control-scroller snapshot passed 230 normal cases but failed the exact HiDPI portrait bound: the native menu required552 logical pixels on a540-pixel workarea. Failure-only preferred-width probes identified the existing menubar, not the hidden placeholder statusbar, as the constraint. Retained failed logs are excluded from acceptance.

The first installed portrait capture showed clipped rightmost controls. A horizontal-only host scroller and exact reachability/native synchronization/finalization case corrected this; final normal and HiDPI suites include the new case.
An initial focused scroll invocation used an unregistered test path and executed zero TAP cases. It is excluded; the corrected exact-path run executed one passing case.
Initial changed-header build route was corrected by using the existing opaque Painter Canvas UI header; no strict header gate was weakened.

Native tests exposed session singleton arbitration, first-draw focus blocking, stale mode replay, pending-restore no-op conversion, and GTK overlay indicator re-realization ordering; each repaired before final snapshot.

Existing regressions exposed settled-single Painter-only dock over-consolidation and wrong dock-side reference with host merge destination; unchanged identity/geometry assertions pass on final snapshot.
Native Move fixture normalized move-type before its exact descendant snapshot; no ownership assertion was relaxed.

Focused actual host focus during a detached-shell gap reproduced a menubar-model critical; the same test passes after local event/idle deferral and checks unchanged Guides/BPC plus zero CtrlW activation.
Temporary diagnostic traces were removed. Failed logs are retained separately from acceptance; no baseline exemption or suppressed child stderr.

Second capture harness read only legacy WM_NAME and missed the UTF-8 image title; it timed out. Corrected _NET_WM_NAME lookup and initialized config-version to avoid first-run welcome overlay; final capture and Quit succeeded.

First application capture harness incorrectly placed session-only single-window-mode in gimprc, causing parse fallback and harness termination before capture. Corrected sessionrc placement, reran from intended profile, and verified normal quit. This failed attempt is not application acceptance.
limitations: Not a new full registered aggregate: accepted b6f0 baseline remains separate.

review: Independent read-only ownership/reentrancy review accepted the final source; temporary preferred-width diagnostics removed.
